markdown_content: ## Clo 2025.0 Features Highlights Overview This document details the key updates and new features in Clo 2025.0, focusing on AI-powered tools, pattern drafting enhancements, animation improvements, 3D visualization upgrades, and workflow optimizations. It covers AI pose and pattern generation, animation keyframes, fur rendering, print layout nesting, avatar customization, UV editor exports, rendering controls, trim attachment, simulation tools, UI improvements, materials and colorway management, grading annotations, and 2DCAD enhancements. --- ## AI Pose Generator and Pattern Drafting Enhancements This section explains Clo's new AI pose generator and advanced pattern drafting capabilities, including parametric measurement adjustments and sketch-based pattern creation. - **Beta AI Pose Generator**: Automatically creates dynamic poses, eliminating time-consuming manual posing. Users can: - Generate poses via Clo's updated prompt system to align closer with design ideas. - Import their own images to create poses. - Save generated poses and apply them across multiple Clo projects. - **Pattern Drafter Improvements**: - Parametric pattern drafting now supports a patented measurement technique to create a range of shirt styles. - Users input measurements, and Clo guides adjustments on the pattern, dynamically updating shape and fit. - After finalizing a pattern, selecting "Create" generates a graded range automatically. - Beta AI Pattern Drafter can generate patterns starting from sketches: - Either generate sketches via prompt tools. - Or import user sketches, which Clo converts into measurements. - Measurements can be further adjusted within the Measurements section before finalizing the pattern. - The system then arranges and sews the design automatically. --- ## Animation Editor and Fur Visualization Updates This section covers the updated Animation Editor UI, new keyframe functionality, asset controls, and 3D fur rendering features. - **Animation Editor UI**: - Introduces keyframes for streamlined animation editing. - Provides enhanced precision and control with a variety of editing options. - Users can activate or deactivate various assets such as gravity and colorways within animations. - Enables creation of more dynamic and complex animations. - **3D Fur Visualization**: - Fur can now be viewed directly within the 3D window. - To enable, switch to "Fur Strand Type" in the Materials section. - Fur rendering updates immediately reflect in both the 3D preview and final render windows. - This addition improves decision-making without switching to the render window. --- ## Print Layout and Production Workflow Improvements This section details enhancements to print layout, texture nesting, and production workflow integration. - **Texture Nesting**: - Clo now reads and follows texture placement within the 3D window when nesting patterns. - Users select "Pattern Matching" and choose either "Print" or "Lock" depending on texture application. - This feature ensures consistent texture alignment from 3D design to production. - Supports a wider range of production categories and unlocks new workflow possibilities. --- ## AI Studio Avatars and Customization This section describes upgrades to AI Studio for avatar generation, background control, and avatar body shaping. - **AI Studio Enhancements**: - New background option to customize avatar environments. - Improved output quality for more realistic images. - Users can adjust both avatar and background independently. - Supports keyword or free-text prompts to generate avatar images. - Users can upload their own images, which the studio adapts to create desired garment contexts. - **Avatar Shaping Controls**: - Hip shaping options allow control over hip curvature (dip inward or outward) and bottom shape (round or flat). - Breast customization includes selectable cup sizes: - Use either custom cup sizes or default Clo sizes. - Cycle through cup sizes to apply on avatars for realistic fitting. --- ## 3D Window, UV Editor, and Rendering Updates This section explains updates to the 3D window interface, UV editor capabilities, and rendering/export controls. - **3D Window and UV Editor**: - The UV editor is now integrated under the Materials and UV toolbar. - Users can export back or side textures from the UV editor for improved compatibility with external software. - **Rendering Updates**: - Colorway selection is now available in the 3D snapshot tool for both single and multi-snapshot exports. - Users can export all or selected colorways at once, streamlining multi-colorway workflows. - Render window and custom views now support depth of field control: - Focus point set by left-click. - Clo automatically applies focus settings to custom views, providing seamless user control. --- ## Trim Attachment and Simulation Tools This section covers improvements to trim attachment workflows and new simulation selection features. - **Trim Attachment**: - The tack tool allows multiple attachment points on a single trim. - Procedure: - Select tack tool, click on the trim or layer tool. - Click "Add Change," then select the trim and the pattern piece for attachment. - Multiple attachment points can be created for complex trim placement. - **Simulation Selection - Advanced Pinching**: - New option in the 3D selection tool. - Users control the selection amount via sliders. - Checkboxes allow selection of specific patterns to affect. - Provides granular control over simulation adjustments. --- ## User Interface and Library Management This section highlights UI improvements related to project file toggles and library organization. - **Project File Toggle Menu**: - When opening project files, users choose whether to use the toggle menu saved in the file or the default toggle menu. - **Library Window Updates**: - New library window introduced for better asset management. - Users can transfer all previous library folders into the new library. - Folder renaming is now supported for better organization. --- ## Materials, Colorways, and Grading Annotations This section details user-friendly updates to materials and colorway tools, and enhanced annotation editing in grading and DXF workflows. - **Materials and Colorways**: - New materials library is open and includes the same tools as Clo's colorways. - Shortcut key "O" opens the colorway editor. - Within the object browser, users can cycle through color chips to preview different colorways. - Colorway editor allows editing of fabric appearance on the front, back, or side. - **Grading and DXF Annotations**: - Annotations in Clo can now be fully edited in the 2D window. - Users can change annotation color, size, text content, and rotation directly, improving clarity and customization. --- ## 2DCAD Curve Editing Enhancements This section explains improvements to the 2DCAD smooth curve tool for pattern editing precision. - **Smooth Curve Tool Upgrades**: - Retains the original curve editing method. - Adds a new method using curve points for enhanced control. - Allows partial pattern adjustments without affecting unrelated areas. - Improves precision in modifying curves, benefiting detailed pattern work. --- ## Additional Features and Closing Notes Clo 2025.0 includes numerous other feature enhancements that elevate editing capabilities and workflows. Upcoming deep dive sessions will provide further insights into these updates. Happy creating!
